method: Inspected the full 30-frame master contact sheet, representative decoded MP4 frames, six decoded frames across the transition, and the icon at 60/80/120 pixels. Combined with full video decoding, geometry clearance and endpoint comparisons. This is desktop image/frame review, not iPhone playback testing.
observations: The bulk bed remains in the same physical bulb while its free surface slides relative to the turning glass.
The camera and floor are stationary; reflections and the contact shadow change with the rotating object.
The polished crown brightens while crossing the studio light reflection, then returns to the original appearance.
The final pose and amount match the existing 100% clip. The flowing-grain phase follows 47 -> 0 at the cut.
At icon sizes the hourglass outline and two sand reservoirs remain readable; tiny lettering is decorative.
limitations: Sand uses a volume-constrained, gravity-oriented mesh and ballistic surface grains. It is an art-directed bake rather than particle-to-particle DEM physics.
The app implementation, timer/alarm tests and installation are assigned to the Mac environment.
